name: Minnesota Assistance Council For Veterans: veteran housing help (SSVF)
description: VA-funded Supportive Services for Veteran Families (SSVF, grant 19-MN-046): case management, help keeping a home, rapid rehousing and short-term financial help for low-income veteran households. Serves: Aitkin County, Anoka County, Becker County, Beltrami County, Benton County, Big Stone County, Blue Earth County, Brown County, Carlton County, Carver County, Cass County, Chippewa County and 75 more.
next_step: Call SSVF intake with your county and housing situation: whether you are homeless now or at risk of losing housing, and who lives with you.
constraints: Serves only the areas listed; check that yours is included. Veteran-household, income and housing-status screening applies.
County and intake details come from VA’s FY26 SSVF provider intake list; confirm current service when calling.
